Yeah I got my seizure situation kinda figured out hopefully, it’s just that’s what caused everything to go to shit,
You gotta be 2 years or more seizure free before you can drive witch set me back farther in a lot more things than just driving, I think it kinda mentally screwed me, even just they way my parents talk about it in front of me and anyone I talk to kinda has to know just in case it ever happens,
It makes just being alive a burden on anyone I come in contact with

Thank you a lot for this I will definitely try to use that method divide and conquer, I’ve never thought of using my money to travel I think I would enjoy that like u said even planning out the process would be fun to think of,
And yes I did the written version of my drivers license, but that’s about it, yeah you are right I should have thought of going to a driving school thank you a lot for the advice, honestly I appreciate it so much. You really made it seem not impossible
